scope: Order-day exact-part fulfillment-route evidence for PD20 lines flagged by stock-review.py on 2026-11-22. Read-only public pages and endpoints. No login, contact, cart, reservation, upload, quote or order.
separation_rules: JLC assembly stock, LCSC retail stock, JLC private (consigned / pre-ordered / Global Sourcing) stock and external distributor stock are separate pools and are never added together.
A documented route is not confirmed acceptance for this order; acceptance, billed quantity, packaging and lead time are confirmed only in the owner's JLC order flow or a supplier response.

stated: paid orders cannot be canceled or returned
parts are stored and listed in the customer parts library
purchasing normally 9-20 business days (sourcing instruction says 9-15 days); review 1-3 business days
USD 20 commodity inspection per kind of part; baking USD 8 per 48 h
customer should allow for minimum assembly quantity and attrition (no number given)
each item needs extra quantity for attrition or minimum assembly requirement (no number given)
loose components accepted with an extra handling fee
import handling fee minimum USD 10 per shipment; duties/VAT deposit; price review within 2 business days
parts go to My Parts Lib
private library; selectable only after arrival at the JLC warehouse
in-stock extended parts: no minimum order quantity; non-stock parts: a minimum order quantity applies
lead time within 18 days proceeds directly

jlc_routes_documented.combination: Global Sourcing parts may be chosen alongside consigned parts in one order (consigned stock matched first).
jlc_routes_documented.field_meanings: minPurchaseNum, leastPatchNumber and lossNumber are not defined on any public JLC help page found; reading them as minimum buy, minimum assembly quantity and attrition is an inference, not a JLC statement. PCBA FAQ part 2 (https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/pcb-assembly-faqs-part-2) says a minimum quantity or extra parts for attrition may be required.
